candidate_operations.summary: GPIO mode: send trigger pulse, measure echo pulse width, compute distance

steps.details: Set Trig pin high for at least 10 microseconds

evidence.snippet: The external MCU applies a high-level pulse longer than 10 uS to Trig.

steps.details: Measure the duration of high pulse on Echo pin (time T)

evidence.snippet: The module returns a high-level pulse proportional to distance; calculate distance from pulse width 'T'.

steps.details: Compute distance using formula distance = T * C / 2

evidence.snippet: Distance=T*C/2  (C is the speed of sound)

Ultrasonic timing diagram. Operation matches the earlier HC-SR04. The external MCU applies a high-level pulse longer than 10 uS to Trig; the module returns a high-level pulse proportional to distance, calculated from pulse width 'T'.

candidate_operations.summary: UART mode: send command 0xA0, read three bytes, compute distance

evidence.snippet: The external MCU or PC sends command 0XA0.

steps.details: Read three bytes: BYTE_H, BYTE_M, BYTE_L

evidence.snippet: After measuring, the module returns three distance bytes: BYTE_H, BYTE_M, and BYTE_L.

Connect the serial port. The external MCU or PC sends 0XA0. After measuring, the module returns three distance bytes: BYTE_H, BYTE_M, and BYTE_L. Distance (mm)=((BYTE_H<<16)+(BYTE_M<<8)+ BYTE_L)/1000.

candidate_operations.summary: IIC mode: write 0x01 to start measurement, wait 200ms, read three bytes, compute distance

evidence.snippet: Write 0X01 to the module to start ranging.
Wait 200 mS (the module's maximum ranging time).

steps.details: Read three bytes: BYTE_H, BYTE_M, BYTE_L

evidence.snippet: Read three distance bytes directly: BYTE_H, BYTE_M, and BYTE_L.

Write 0X01 to start ranging; wait at least 200 mS (the module's maximum ranging time). Read three distance bytes directly: BYTE_H, BYTE_M, and BYTE_L. Distance (mm)=((BYTE_H<<16)+(BYTE_M<<8)+ BYTE_L)/1000.
